UPDATE (Nov 13): We're no longer taking applications for these roles. Thanks to everyone who applied.

Bridge AI Consulting | AI Consultant, Junior AI Consultant | REMOTE (US) | Full-time | $60K–$100K base + upside for new business, equity possible | Visa sponsorship possible

We're a small, bootstrapped, profitable AI consulting firm. We embed with small and mid-size businesses (wealth management, real estate, construction, higher ed, nonprofits), learn how the work actually gets done, build what makes sense (mostly Claude: skills, agents, connectors, MCP) and train every person until they don't need us. We went from 1 client in February to about 20.

You'd own client relationships end to end: discovery, the build, the training. Strong builders who can also explain things to a 60-year-old business owner do very well here.

Apply (written answers + a short video, about an hour): https://www.bridgeaiconsulting.com/careers?src=hn
